preconditions: The request explicitly asks for UI/UX design, diagnosis, improvement, or review, or authorized interface work needs a concrete user-flow, interaction, responsive-layout, or accessibility decision.

The work concerns an actual web, desktop, or mobile interface or its design. Incidental UI/UX words in logs, backend-only changes, and standalone image or icon generation do not establish applicability.

Direct use does not require a new workflow. This optional formal provider produces design or review artifacts; source changes follow the existing authorized mutation and implementation flow. Preserve the existing task scope, design system, evidence, and acceptance and audit obligations.
providers.failureHandling: Return NEEDS_INPUT only for material missing input while preserving useful completed work. ANALYZED finishes the stated design or review scope; it does not prove UI behavior, accessibility conformance, performance, acceptance, or independent audit. Keep NOT_RUN and unavailable observations distinct from verified results. This stage grants no new implementation or release authority.
